content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was that a change made in commit 721cabf6c660 to move the Power Gating Controller (PGC) handling to a new GPC driver inadvertently broke the compatibility with the imx6sl GPC power domain support. Specifically, the modified code assumed a fixed number of domains (2) when initializing power domains, which resulted in failing to find the appropriate device tree (DT) node for the PGC, leading to the error message: "could not find pgc DT node." The patch reinstates legacy support by allowing dynamic handling of the number of power domains based on the device tree configuration instead of hardcoding it.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: - dev_err(&pdev->dev, "could not find pgc DT node\n");
